#!/bin/bash
REPO="/bench/repo"
STORE_IMPORT="github.com/usememos/memos/store"

declare -A ENTITY_DECL
ENTITY_DECL[Memo]="store/memo.go"
ENTITY_DECL[User]="store/user.go"
ENTITY_DECL[Attachment]="store/attachment.go"
ENTITY_DECL[Inbox]="store/inbox.go"
ENTITY_DECL[Reaction]="store/reaction.go"
ENTITY_DECL[IdentityProvider]="store/idp.go"
ENTITY_DECL[InstanceSetting]="store/instance_setting.go"
ENTITY_DECL[MemoRelation]="store/memo_relation.go"
ENTITY_DECL[MemoShare]="store/memo_share.go"
ENTITY_DECL[UserIdentity]="store/user_identity.go"
ENTITY_DECL[UserSetting]="store/user_setting.go"
ENTITY_DECL[AuthenticationConfigState]="store/auth_config.go"

is_store_layer() {
  local f="$1"
  [[ "$f" == */store/* ]] && return 0
  [[ "$f" == */proto/gen/store/* ]] && return 0
  [[ "$f" == */proto/store/* ]] && return 0
  return 1
}

dir_to_pkg() {
  local d="$1"
  d="${d#$REPO/}"
  echo "github.com/usememos/memos/$d"
}

# temp files for entity->packages
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
for e in "${!ENTITY_DECL[@]}"; do
  touch "$TMPDIR/$e"
done
for vt in RowStatus Visibility Role; do
  touch "$TMPDIR/$vt"
done

echo "=== ALL STORE ROOT PACKAGE STRUCT DECLARATIONS ==="
for f in "$REPO"/store/*.go; do
  [[ "$f" == *_test.go ]] && continue
  fn=$(basename "$f")
  line=0
  while IFS= read -r l; do
    ((line++))
    if [[ "$l" =~ ^type\ ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\ struct ]]; then
      name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      if [[ -n "${ENTITY_DECL[$name]}" ]]; then kind="ENTITY"; else kind="DTO/INFRA"; fi
      printf "  %-35s [%-12s] store/%s:%d\n" "$name" "$kind" "$fn" "$line"
    fi
  done < "$f"
done

# Process all external go files
while IFS= read -r gofile; do
  is_store_layer "$gofile" && continue
  dir=$(dirname "$gofile")
  pkg=$(dir_to_pkg "$dir")
  
  # check if file imports store
  if ! grep -q "$STORE_IMPORT" "$gofile" 2>/dev/null; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # extract aliases - simplified: store default + any alias before import path
  aliases="store"
  while IFS= read -r imp_line; do
  # from import blocks - crude but works
    if [[ "$imp_line" =~ ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)[[:space:]]+\"$STORE_IMPORT\" ]]; then
      aliases="$aliases ${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    elif [[ "$imp_line" =~ \"$STORE_IMPORT\" ]]; then
      aliases="$aliases store"
    fi
  done < <(grep -E "$STORE_IMPORT|^[[:space:]]*(store|[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]+\"" "$gofile" | grep "$STORE_IMPORT" || true)
  
  # also check single-line import alias patterns in full file
  if grep -qE '\b[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*[[:space:]]+"'"$STORE_IMPORT"'"' "$gofile"; then
    extra=$(grep -oE '\b[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*[[:space:]]+"'"$STORE_IMPORT"'"' "$gofile" | awk '{print $1}')
    aliases="$aliases $extra"
  fi
  
  for alias in $aliases; do
    for entity in "${!ENTITY_DECL[@]}" RowStatus Visibility Role; do
      if grep -qE "\b${alias}\.${entity}\b" "$gofile"; then
        if ! grep -qx "$pkg" "$TMPDIR/$entity" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "$pkg" >> "$TMPDIR/$entity"
        fi
      fi
    done
  done
done < <(find "$REPO" -name '*.go' -type f)

echo ""
echo "=== PERSISTENT ENTITY EXTERNAL PACKAGE COUNTS ==="
for entity in Memo User Attachment Inbox Reaction IdentityProvider InstanceSetting MemoRelation MemoShare UserIdentity UserSetting AuthenticationConfigState; do
  count=$(sort -u "$TMPDIR/$entity" 2>/dev/null | grep -c . || echo 0)
  printf "  %-25s %3d pkgs  (%s)\n" "$entity" "$count" "${ENTITY_DECL[$entity]}"
done | sort -t' ' -k2 -nr

echo ""
echo "=== DETAILED TOP ENTITIES ==="
for entity in User Memo; do
  count=$(sort -u "$TMPDIR/$entity" | grep -c . || echo 0)
  echo ""
  echo "--- $entity ($count external packages) ---"
  sort -u "$TMPDIR/$entity"
done

echo ""
echo "=== VALUE TYPES ==="
for vt in RowStatus Visibility Role; do
  count=$(sort -u "$TMPDIR/$vt" 2>/dev/null | grep -c . || echo 0)
  printf "  %-15s %3d\n" "$vt" "$count"
done

rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
BASHEOF

## Notes on zero-ref entities

`IdentityProvider`, `InstanceSetting`, `UserSetting`, and `AuthenticationConfigState` have **no** qualified `store.<Type>` references outside the data layer. Upper layers interact with them via `Find*`/`Update*` DTOs or protobuf types at the API boundary — e.g. `idp_service.go` uses `store.FindIdentityProvider` and `storepb.IdentityProvider`, not `store.IdentityProvider` in external signatures. That does not make them non-entities; they are simply less visible as named types above the store layer.
